window: Past 24 hours. Search indexes lagged badly and returned almost nothing dated in the window; the single story here describes a raid from 2 November. No new SOUTHCOM strike announcements could be verified.

stories.headline: Jamaican SWAT team finds about 69 kg of cocaine in a Papine house and detains one man
stories.summary: Police officers serving a search warrant at a home on University Crescent in Papine, St Andrew, around 11:30 pm on 2 November found roughly 152 pounds of cocaine.
